Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to remain, to be left', paired with 'оставаться'.

передать.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

meanings.en: to pass on, to hand over, to give
meanings.note: + accusative and dative (кому). Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'дать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to pass on, to hand over', paired with 'передавать'.

meanings.note: Подожди! = wait!. Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to wait (a while)', paired with 'ждать'.

Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to say goodbye, to bid farewell', paired with 'прощаться'.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

meanings.note: 'это просто' = it's easy. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.en: to have fun, to amuse oneself
meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'влекаться'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to have fun'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.
